cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: The agent's reasoning loop (observe -> think -> act over a local codebase) applies autonomous-agent orchestration to secure-coding review, so SMEs and regulated teams (fintech, health-tech) without cloud-tooling budgets or the ability to send code off-premises can still get baseline vulnerability and correctness checks before shipping.
